name: Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana
_eligibility_text:
1. Applicant must be a widow women from Rajasthan State.
1. Applicant must be resident of Rajasthan or living in Rajasthan for 3 years before re-marriage.
1. Applicant should be entitled to pension as per widow pension rules.
1. Applicant age should be between 18-50 years.
1. If the applicant has remarried before this scheme then he/she will not be eligible.
